# grep

Search files or standard input for matching records through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/grep -n 'error' app.log

moonx cli/grep -E 'warn|error' app.log

moonx cli/grep -F 'literal.text' input.txt
```

Use basic regular expressions by default, -E for extended expressions or -F for literals. Exit 0 for a match, 1 for no match and 2 for errors.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-F`, `--fixed-strings` | Match literal strings. |
| `-E`, `--extended-regexp` | Use extended regular expressions. |
| `-o`, `--only-matching` | Print each nonempty matched part separately. |
| `-i`, `--ignore-case` | Ignore ASCII case differences. |
| `-n`, `--line-number` | Print record numbers. |
| `-r`, `--recursive` | Recurse without following links. |
| `-C VALUE`, `--context VALUE` | Print this many records before and after a match. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Matching uses C-locale byte classes and ASCII case folding, not Unicode locale rules. Backreferences may require additional work and memory.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
